enforcedRules: Full row-level presence verification before database insertion
Date, keyword, region, and demandValue matching
Demote reused CSV SHAs with tampered demand values to CACHED_UNVERIFIED in TemporalDemandEngine

securityGuards.whatwgUrlNormalization: Enforced (https only, default port 443, no userinfo, punycode validated)
securityGuards.dnsResolutionPrecheck: All resolved A/AAAA addresses verified against blocked CIDRs before socket connect
securityGuards.dnsRebindingDefense: Connected peer IP verified against DNS-resolved set
securityGuards.manualHopByHopRedirectTraversal: Max 5 hops, same domain preserved, HTTPS->HTTP downgrade blocked, redirect loops detected
securityGuards.streamingBodyCap: 2 MiB (2097152 bytes) limit strictly enforced; reader.cancel() aborts stream immediately to prevent OOM
securityGuards.productContentProof: JSON-LD schema.org/Product entity OR OpenGraph og:type='product' OR title compatibility required
securityGuards.antiBotChallengeDetection: Cloudflare / CAPTCHA challenge pages detected and rejected fail-closed
